subjects.title: Chemistry
subjects.book: Okoye, Model Textbook of Chemistry for Senior Secondary Schools (SS1 part)
subjects.caveat: Extracted from a text PDF. Reaction arrows were restored automatically as →; a reaction that is really reversible (⇌) may show as →. Subscripts are flattened (H2O means H₂O). Diagrams are missing.

topics.title: Introduction to chemistry
topics.scheme: Meaning of chemistry, scientific method of learning chemistry, careers in chemistry

topics.title: Adverse effects of chemistry
topics.scheme: Corrosion, pollution, drug abuse
sources: Okoye ch.2 (see Pollution, Corrosion of Metals, Drug Abuse)

topics.title: Chemical industries
topics.scheme: Types of chemical industries; importance of chemistry and chemical industries to the nation and the individual

topics.title: Separation techniques
topics.scheme: Filtration, evaporation, decantation, crystallization, fractional crystallization, chromatography, sublimation, pure and impure substances, distillation, fractional distillation, precipitation
sources: Okoye ch.9 (mixtures, pure and impure substances)

topics.title: Particulate nature of matter
topics.scheme: Physical and chemical changes; atoms and molecules; Dalton's atomic theory; protons, neutrons and electrons; arrangement of electrons; atomic number, mass number, isotopes, relative atomic masses
sources: Okoye ch.9 (physical and chemical changes, elements, compounds, mixtures)

topics.title: Symbols, Latin names and the first 20 elements
topics.scheme: Not on the scheme but asked in the first term exam: symbols of elements, Latin names (Natrium, Kalium, Ferrum), first twenty elements and their symbols

topics.title: Laws of chemical combination and equations
Gas laws, the mole and molar volume

subjects.title: Biology
subjects.book: SS1 first term school notes (spine) + Biology Matters GCE O Level 3e (Lam Peng Kwan) + Biology: A Course for O Level (EPUB)
subjects.caveat: The notes follow the Nigerian scheme and wording: prefer them when sources differ. The O level books are Singaporean: use them for deeper explanation only. Diagrams are missing.

topics.title: Classification II: Plantae and Animalia
topics.scheme: Kingdom Plantae, Kingdom Animalia

topics.title: The cell
topics.scheme: Cell as a living unit, forms in which cells exist, cell structure and functions, the cell theory, differences and similarities between plant and animal cells

topics.title: The cell and its environment; plant nutrition
topics.scheme: Diffusion, osmosis, plant nutrition, micro and macro nutrients

topics.title: Animal nutrition, balanced diet, enzymes, food tests
topics.scheme: Animal nutrition, balanced diet, enzymes, food test

topics.title: Respiration, excretion and growth
topics.scheme: Cellular respiration, excretion, growth

topics.title: Irritability, movement and reproduction
topics.scheme: Cell reaction to its environment, movement, reproduction

topics.title: Tissues and supporting systems
topics.scheme: Skeleton and supporting systems in animals: biological significance, forms and types of skeleton, bones of the vertebral column, joints, functions of the skeleton

subjects.title: Mathematics
subjects.book: New General Mathematics for Senior Secondary Schools 1 (Pearson, 2011)
subjects.caveat: Scanned book read by OCR. Powers and superscripts are often flattened or misread: '10?' or '104' may mean 10² or 10⁴, '107' may be 10⁻². Fractions may be broken across lines. Work from the method, not the exact digits, and never quote a garbled number to the student.

topics.title: Number bases I
topics.scheme: Decimal base (10) and other bases (2, 3 etc.); conversion between base 10 and other bases

topics.title: Number bases II
topics.scheme: Problem solving: addition, subtraction, multiplication and division in number bases

topics.title: Modular arithmetic
topics.scheme: Modular arithmetic (listed with number bases in week 2)

topics.title: Indices
topics.scheme: Laws of indices; multiplication and simple exponential equations

topics.title: Standard form
topics.scheme: Writing numbers in index form; addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and square root in standard form

topics.title: Logarithms I
topics.scheme: Deduction of logarithm form from index and standard form

topics.title: Logarithms II
topics.scheme: Calculations involving multiplication and division using log and antilog tables

topics.title: Logarithms III
topics.scheme: Calculations involving powers and roots

topics.title: Sets I
topics.scheme: Definition of sets; notation; listing; set builder; types of sets (universal, empty, finite, infinite)

topics.title: Set operations and Venn diagrams
topics.scheme: Union, intersection, complement, Venn diagrams

topics.title: Change of subject of formula
topics.scheme: Simple equations; change of subject of formula with roots, powers and brackets

topics.title: Variation and simultaneous equations
topics.scheme: Variation; simultaneous equations

subjects.title: English Language
subjects.book: New Oxford Secondary English Course for Senior Secondary Schools 1 (University Press)
subjects.caveat: The school follows its own weekly topics, so each week pulls the closest book sections. Phonetic symbols (IPA) are often garbled by OCR: teach sounds from standard British RP. Where the book has nothing on a scheme item (irregular verbs, nominalization), teach it from standard English grammar and say it is not in his textbook.

topics.title: The /kw/ sound, religion words, plural nouns
topics.scheme: Spoken English: consonant /k/ followed by /w/ (quest, quench, quarter); vocabulary associated with traditional religion (shrine, cult, diviner); reading short prose passages; rules for forming plural nouns

topics.title: Meaning from context, family words, narrative essay, noun gender
topics.scheme: Word meaning through context; words associated with family (uncle, siblings, ancestors); listening to poems, stories, drama; narrative composition 'My first day at college'; nouns: masculine, feminine, common, neuter gender
sources: Oxford Term 1 Unit 1 (Home and Family Life)

topics.title: Sounds /s/ /z/ /ʒ/, farming words, countable nouns
topics.scheme: Pronunciation practice /s/, /z/, /ʒ/, /e/, /ə/; words associated with agriculture (cocoyam, cassava, staking, pruning); passages for contextual meaning; countable and uncountable nouns; narrative composition 'A day I will never forget'

topics.title: Kinds of nouns
topics.scheme: Proper, common, concrete and collective nouns
sources: Oxford Term 1 Unit 2 (Proper and Common Nouns)
Oxford Term 1 Unit 3 (More about Common Nouns)

topics.title: Consonant + /l/, farm tools, the noun phrase
topics.scheme: Consonant followed by /l/ (sweep); words associated with farm implements (tractor, harvester, hoe, axe); noun phrase and the role of the definite article

topics.title: Listening, using a dictionary, noun phrases
topics.scheme: Listening to real-life speech; use of dictionary for contextual meaning; narrative composition; phrases with the definite article

topics.title: Descriptive essay, fishing words, nominalizer verbs
topics.scheme: Descriptive composition 'A petrol station'; words associated with fishing; nominalizer verbs (wise, wisdom)

topics.title: Listening for key ideas, flood composition, nominalization
topics.scheme: Listening to a recorded conversation for key ideas; composition 'A flood disaster caused by blocked drains'; nominalization of verbs

topics.title: Animal husbandry words, consonant + /j/, irregular verbs
topics.scheme: Words associated with animal husbandry; consonants followed by /j/; descriptive composition 'A fire accident in my street'; irregular verbs

subjects.title: Physics
subjects.book: M.W. Anyakoha, New School Physics for Senior Secondary Schools
